import json, os, sys
from p05_test_runtime import FaultControls
from vortex_ai import Session, Tensor, BindingError
bundle = os.environ['P05_TEST_BUNDLE']
fmt = os.environ['P05_TEST_DTYPE']
controls = FaultControls.activate(bundle)
session = Session.open(bundle)
fault = 'healthy'
name = 'matmul_shapes'
if fault == 'cleanup':
    controls.fail('event_release', occurrence=1)
elif fault == 'async':
    controls.async_failure(4, code=6)
a = Tensor(bytearray([0x12] * 128), dtype=fmt, shape=(8, 8), layout='row_major')
b = Tensor(bytearray([0x34] * 64), dtype=fmt, shape=(8, 4), layout='column_major')
operation = session.submit(a, b)
waited = operation.wait(1000000000)
result = operation.close(0)
assert result.complete and result.primary == (6 if fault == 'async' else 0)
assert result.cleanup == (10 if fault == 'cleanup' else 0)
before_repeat = controls.counters
assert operation.close(0) == result
assert controls.counters == before_repeat
if fault == 'cleanup':
    before = controls.counter('calls:enqueue')
    try:
        session.submit(a, b)
    except BindingError as error:
        if error.operation is not None:
            assert error.operation.close(0).complete
    else:
        raise AssertionError('poisoned owner accepted new work')
    assert controls.counter('calls:enqueue') == before
failed = False
try:
    exec("assert session.close().ok\nif name == 'cleanup_failure':\n    before = controls.counter('calls:device_open')\n    try:\n        Session.open(bundle)\n    except BindingError as error:\n        assert error.kind == 'state' and 'cleanup failed' in str(error)\n    else:\n        raise AssertionError('process cleanup poison was bypassed')\n    assert controls.counter('calls:device_open') == before")
except AssertionError:
    failed = True
closed = session.close()
counts = controls.counters
assert session.close() == closed
assert controls.counters == counts
controls.assert_no_resources()
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({'format': fmt, 'fault': fault, 'case_label': name,
                  'test_assertion_rejected': failed,
                  'operation_status': [result.complete, result.primary, result.cleanup],
                  'owner_status': [closed.complete, closed.primary, closed.cleanup],
                  'repeated_close_native_calls_unchanged': True,
                  'torch_imported': False, 'resources': controls.counters['resources']}))
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)

import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

ROOT = Path('/tmp/ai-gpu-serial-20261121')
BASE = '94267b34d1d2183c744a0c0f2cd1089966c00c21'
PATH = 'ci/project/p05_torch_native_host_tests.py'
TEMP = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='w07-a05-review-'))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'ci/project'))
from p05_test_runtime import TestRuntime

def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def dump(node):
    return ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)

def expr(text):
    return ast.parse(text).body[0]

def child(module):
    return next(node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'child')

def final_tail(module):
    body = child(module).body
    start = next(i for i, node in enumerate(body)
                 if dump(node) == dump(expr('adapter.close()')))
    stop = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(body)) if isinstance(body[i], ast.For))
    return ast.Module(body=copy.deepcopy(body[start + 1:stop]), type_ignores=[])

old_bytes = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + PATH], cwd=ROOT)
new_bytes = (ROOT / PATH).read_bytes()
old, new = ast.parse(old_bytes), ast.parse(new_bytes)
normalized = copy.deepcopy(new)
normalized_child = child(normalized)
repeat = dump(expr('assert operation.close(0) == result'))
parents = [node for node in ast.walk(normalized_child)
           if isinstance(node, ast.If) and any(dump(item) == repeat for item in node.body)]
assert len(parents) == 1
parents[0].body = [node for node in parents[0].body if dump(node) != repeat]
owner = next(i for i, node in enumerate(normalized_child.body)
             if dump(node) == dump(expr('closed = session.close()')))
normalized_child.body[owner] = expr('assert session.close().ok')
branch = normalized_child.body[owner + 1]
assert isinstance(branch, ast.If)
assert dump(branch.body[0]) == dump(expr('assert closed.complete and closed.primary == 0 and closed.cleanup == 10'))
assert dump(branch.body[1]) == dump(expr('assert session.close() == closed'))
assert len(branch.orelse) == 1 and dump(branch.orelse[0]) == dump(expr('assert closed.ok'))
branch.body = branch.body[2:]
branch.orelse = []
assert dump(normalized) == dump(old), 'unexpected change outside the two reviewed blocks'
assignments = {node.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(node.value)
               for node in new.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
               and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name)
               and node.targets[0].id in ('SCENARIOS', 'MODEL_NAMES', 'SCOPE')}
assert len(assignments['SCENARIOS']) == 9
tails = {name: ast.unparse(final_tail(module)) for name, module in [('old', old), ('new', new)]}
for name, text in tails.items():
    (TEMP / (name + '-tail.py.txt')).write_text(text + '\n')

retained = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/project/evidence/p06-serial-workspace/host/p05-boundary/results.json').read_text())
bundle_root = Path('/tmp/p06-w03-a01-native-binding')
report = {'scope': 'independent-compiled-owner-close-tail-review', 'baseline': BASE,
          'test_before_sha256': sha(old_bytes), 'test_after_sha256': sha(new_bytes),
          'ast_scope_exact': True, 'unchanged_scenarios': list(assignments['SCENARIOS']),
          'unchanged_model_names': list(assignments['MODEL_NAMES']),
          'torch_available': importlib.util.find_spec('torch') is not None,
          'torch_execution': False, 'native_accelerator_execution': False,
          'tail_sources': tails, 'bundles': [], 'children': []}

cases = [('old', 'healthy', 'matmul_shapes', 0), ('old', 'cleanup', 'cleanup_failure', 1),
         ('new', 'healthy', 'matmul_shapes', 0), ('new', 'cleanup', 'cleanup_failure', 0),
         ('new', 'async', 'async_failure', 0),
         ('new', 'healthy', 'cleanup_failure', 1), ('new', 'cleanup', 'matmul_shapes', 1)]
began = time.monotonic()
for fmt in ('fp16', 'bf16'):
    root = bundle_root / fmt
    manifest_path = root / 'bundle/manifest.json'
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    expected = retained['builds'][fmt]
    assert manifest['binding_sources'] == expected['binding_sources']
    assert len(manifest['binding_sources']) == 63
    for row in manifest['binding_sources']:
        body = (ROOT / row['path']).read_bytes()
        assert len(body) == row['size'] and sha(body) == row['sha256'], row['path']
    for row in manifest['artifacts']:
        body = (root / 'bundle' / row['path']).read_bytes()
        assert len(body) == row['size'] and sha(body) == row['sha256'], row['path']
    extension, = (root / 'python/vortex_ai').glob('_native.*.so')
    assert sha(extension.read_bytes()) == expected['extension_sha256']
    assert sha(manifest_path.read_bytes()) == expected['manifest_sha256']
    packages = []
    for path in sorted((root / 'python/vortex_ai').glob('*.py')):
        assert path.read_bytes() == (ROOT / 'python/vortex_ai' / path.name).read_bytes()
        packages.append(path.name)
    report['bundles'].append({'format': fmt, 'source_count': 63,
                              'artifact_count': len(manifest['artifacts']),
                              'package_files': packages, 'extension_sha256': expected['extension_sha256'],
                              'manifest_sha256': expected['manifest_sha256']})
    runtime = TestRuntime(root, root / 'bundle', root / 'python', extension,
                          root / 'generated/p05_build_config.h', fmt, ())
    for version, fault, name, expected_exit in cases:
        code = '''import json, os, sys
from p05_test_runtime import FaultControls
from vortex_ai import Session, Tensor, BindingError
bundle = os.environ['P05_TEST_BUNDLE']
fmt = os.environ['P05_TEST_DTYPE']
controls = FaultControls.activate(bundle)
session = Session.open(bundle)
fault = FAULT
name = NAME
if fault == 'cleanup':
    controls.fail('event_release', occurrence=1)
elif fault == 'async':
    controls.async_failure(4, code=6)
a = Tensor(bytearray([0x12] * 128), dtype=fmt, shape=(8, 8), layout='row_major')
b = Tensor(bytearray([0x34] * 64), dtype=fmt, shape=(8, 4), layout='column_major')
operation = session.submit(a, b)
waited = operation.wait(1000000000)
result = operation.close(0)
assert result.complete and result.primary == (6 if fault == 'async' else 0)
assert result.cleanup == (10 if fault == 'cleanup' else 0)
before_repeat = controls.counters
OP_REPEAT
assert controls.counters == before_repeat
if fault == 'cleanup':
    before = controls.counter('calls:enqueue')
    try:
        session.submit(a, b)
    except BindingError as error:
        if error.operation is not None:
            assert error.operation.close(0).complete
    else:
        raise AssertionError('poisoned owner accepted new work')
    assert controls.counter('calls:enqueue') == before
failed = False
try:
    exec(TAIL)
except AssertionError:
    failed = True
closed = session.close()
counts = controls.counters
assert session.close() == closed
assert controls.counters == counts
controls.assert_no_resources()
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({'format': fmt, 'fault': fault, 'case_label': name,
                  'test_assertion_rejected': failed,
                  'operation_status': [result.complete, result.primary, result.cleanup],
                  'owner_status': [closed.complete, closed.primary, closed.cleanup],
                  'repeated_close_native_calls_unchanged': True,
                  'torch_imported': False, 'resources': controls.counters['resources']}))
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
'''.replace('FAULT', repr(fault)).replace('NAME', repr(name)).replace('TAIL', repr(tails[version]))
        code = code.replace('OP_REPEAT', ast.unparse(expr('assert operation.close(0) == result')))
        label = '-'.join((fmt, version, fault, name))
        path = TEMP / (label + '.py')
        path.write_text(code)
        start = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(path)], cwd=runtime.root,
                                env=runtime.environment(), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        observation = json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout else None
        row = {'label': label, 'argv': [sys.executable, str(path)], 'cwd': str(runtime.root),
               'timeout_seconds': 20, 'expected_exit': expected_exit, 'actual_exit': result.returncode,
               'seconds': round(time.monotonic() - start, 3), 'stdout': result.stdout,
               'stderr': result.stderr, 'source': code, 'source_sha256': sha(code.encode()),
               'observation': observation}
        report['children'].append(row)
        assert result.returncode == expected_exit and not result.stderr, row
        assert observation['test_assertion_rejected'] == bool(expected_exit)
report['seconds'] = round(time.monotonic() - began, 3)
report['source_stable'] = (ROOT / PATH).read_bytes() == new_bytes
assert report['source_stable']
report['outcome'] = 'pass'
(TEMP / 'review.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'result': str(TEMP / 'review.json'), 'children': len(report['children']),
                  'seconds': report['seconds'], 'outcome': report['outcome']}))
limitations: This exercises exact old/current close-tail statements over real compiled host-only fault runtimes; it does not run TorchSession or the full nine PyTorch scenario bodies.
The optional host runner requires the pinned PyTorch environment and 10 GiB reserve; it was not invoked and no prerequisite was relaxed.
The compiled test bundles name their earlier build source revision; all 63 bound source bodies, artifacts, extension and Python package identities were rechecked against the current runtime.
No full repository suite, accelerator arithmetic, native simulator, hardware execution, build, installation, commit or push was performed by this review.
The real hosted PyTorch gate and root integration/publication obligations remain separate.
